meta.name: local-seo
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "do local SEO", optimize a Google Business Profile, fix NAP, or build local citations; produces a GBP optimization checklist, a consistent NAP record, a priority-ordered citation list, and location/service-area page plans. Not for general on-page issues — use on-page-seo-auditor; not for keyword demand — use keyword-research. 本地SEO/谷歌商家档案/引用建设/NAP一致性

copy.tagline: 优化本地商家在谷歌搜索和地图上的排名
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经营本地实体店或服务区域，想提升谷歌搜索和地图曝光。
copy.tagline_en: Boost local business visibility on Google Search and Maps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run a local brick-and-mortar or service-area business and want to rank higher on Google.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你优化本地搜索排名：整理商家名称、地址、电话（NAP）的统一写法，检查并优化 Google 商家档案，列出需要注册的本地目录网站，并规划每个门店或服务区域的专属页面。
howto.when: 当你要求“做本地 SEO”、优化 Google 商家档案、检查 NAP 一致性、建设本地引用，或提到本地包、Google 地图、多门店 SEO 时触发。

say.text: 帮我的咖啡店“晨光咖啡”做本地 SEO，它在上海静安区。
say.note: Claude 会要求确认商家信息，然后生成优化清单。

say.text: 检查“晨光咖啡”的 NAP 一致性，并列出需要注册的目录网站。
say.note: Claude 会对比现有目录，给出优先级排序的引用列表。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude helps optimize local search rankings: standardize business name, address, phone (NAP), audit and improve Google Business Profile, build a priority-ordered citation list, and plan location or service-area pages.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "do local SEO", optimize a Google Business Profile, fix NAP, build citations, or mention local pack, Google Maps, or multi-location SEO.

say_en.text: Do local SEO for my coffee shop "Morning Coffee" in Jing'an, Shanghai.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for business details and produce an optimization checklist.

say_en.text: Audit NAP consistency for "Morning Coffee" and give me a citation priority list.
say_en.note: Claude will compare existing directories and rank citation sources.

say_en.text: We're an HVAC company covering 5 cities — plan our GBP and location pages.
say_en.note: Claude will plan service-area pages accordingly.
